headline: Maroc Telecom Sales Rise 5% to $2.92B as Net Profit Declines 30%
summary: Maroc Telecom recorded a 5.1% rise in nine-month sales to $2.92 billion, but net profit fell 30% to $393 million following a one-off gain booked in 2025.
why: Maroc Telecom is the dominant telecom operator in Morocco and has extensive mobile and fixed-line operations across West and Central Africa.

impacts.name: Maroc Telecom
impacts.why: Steady top-line growth is tempered by lower reported net earnings due to high prior-year base effects.
